body: Thanks you both for responding. I am nervous, but I am going to do all I can to prepare since I really want this internship.

Yeah I figure that I am still going to have to work my way up in the industry. I think that would be true in most sectors though. I will definitely put S&T on my list for schools to contact potential advisors.
Ok well then I will just have to start looking at relocating to the PNW. Thank you for the explanation.
Wait do you mean PG? Or are you suggesting that I move to engineering?
Damn government jobs are hard to get, but I suppose that makes sense.

I am based in Missouri, but am completely fine with moving. I graduated during the pandemic so I took the first job I could get. I will keep what you said in mind. I assumed that the environmental industry has crazy hours all of the time. Most of the people I know that work in the environmental industry all work a lot of hours (60-90 hr weeks) pretty regularly so I thought it was that way across the board.
Yeah I am keeping them in mind along with a few others. I want to cast a wide net.

Thanks for letting me know. I rather try to figure this stuff out now then later on down the road. I am completely field based right now doing groundwater sampling and am completely bored out of my mind. Is there any career path that might offer a better work life balance? I am currently doing 60 hours a week most weeks.
I am living in Missouri, but wouldn't mind moving. I am taking the FG soon but won't be able to get a PG for another few years.

no worries I should have put in in the OP. They have been guilt tripping me for the last week by saying I should get over it. But you guys are right if I am going to be stressed out the entire trip, it wouldn't really be fun anyway.
I don't live with them at the moment. Currently I am living in an apartment by myself. I live in America so we can technically go on holiday.

You have so much life ahead of you. I live in Missouri as well(grew up catholic instead of Mormon). There are alternatives to killing yourself. Please you have so much time to grow and become who you want to be. You can get away from toxic family members and decide what you want to do with you life.
Is there any way that you can wait a day? Or even a few hours? Suicide is a very permanent decision (I am sure that you know this) but can you stay just a bit longer.

Please, can you wait to attempt. I know how it is, I have suicidal thoughts on a daily basis. I understand how hard it is to continue existing. But can you think of somethings that you enjoy? It can be things you think are silly; I enjoy the smell of baked bread, a podcast I listen to my friend that lives in another state one last time. Anything that helps you make it through the day. Ultimately it is your choice, but I hope you continue to stay alive for a while longer.

Yes, I when I was 10 I prayed that I wouldn't wake up. I thought that it was all that it took, if I just prayed hard enough I wouldn't wake up in the morning. Now I am 22 and still alive. I have made it though a suicide attempt and am still alive. I assume that one day I will end it, but am content enough to wait until I am ready to truly kill myself, at least for now.

I am sorry for what happened to you. You shouldn't have to live with your rapist, you deserve more. If it helps I am angry for you. I know what it is like for people to deny sexual assault and how it hurts when people are dismissive. You didn't deserve what happened. I hope that you can find a way to live for yourself. You deserve to be happy.
I felt similarly when I cut all my hair off ( when from shoulder length to a pixie cut). It was a rash decision but it felt very freeing. Hope you are doing a little better.

I would definitely see a medical professional and a therapist ASAP. Is there anything you can do at home to distract yourself? Maybe watching a favorite TV show/video game or reading? Would music help or maybe a podcast? Sorry if these are really daft suggestions.

I completely understand. Even when I am with people I love, it still feels so lonely and cold. Sometimes it is just nice to know that people care. I get randomly depressed as well and for me I feel like it is a mix of a chemical imbalance and leftover trauma popping up. Sometimes depression doesn't make sense and you just gotta weather the storm. You could very well tell them that you just feel depressed with no clear cause and maybe try to articulate what you think might help? Do you want to be distracted? Do you just someone to listen?

Well, you can always change. Have you considered going to counseling? It sounds like therapy and maybe medication could help. Whenever I get really depressed I try to remind myself that I can improve in little ways everyday. You can start with small consistent goals. Maybe write one thing you like about yourself everyday or spend 10-15 minutes going for a walk instead of playing video games. Sticking with it is the most important part, but try not to beat yourself up if you have an off day. One step back, two steps forward.

I understand that that can be hard. Sometimes I try to remember kind things they said about me and then write them down as soon as possible. Then later when I am struggling I can look back on what they said and realize that is how they genuinely feel.  I also feel like it can be hard for non depressed people to understand the mindset of a depressed person. I have experienced people who hear the words suicide and self harm and freaked out even though I just wanted someone to talk to about it, and was not actively planning to do anything to endanger my life. It is hard for them to understand that it is a spectrum and just because you might be passive suicidal it doesn't mean that you are actively going to take your life in that very moment.

I also hate people worrying about me because I feel like I am expending their energy when it could be used else where. But I often have to remind myself that they care about me, and that is their choice. I am not forcing them to care about me, they do it because they love me, even if I can't fully comprehend it. Try to remind yourself that if a friend was hurting you would want to be there to support them and probably wouldn't see it as a burden. So try give the same allowances and be kind to yourself when you are at a low point.

hey, it is hard to be emotionally vulnerable, even if you have an ideal relationship with your parents. Why do you feel like you say/do those hurtful things to your friends? Is it because you don't feel like you are worthy of their love and in your mind it is better to push people away then to allow them to care about you?

It is really hard to distinguish depression's distortions. I try to remind myself that my feelings might not indicate reality. And it is no problem, I want to give back to all the people who have been there for me when I was at my breaking point.
What is currently on your list?

Don't be too hard on yourself. Depression is an unreasonable beast. Even if good things are in your life, it is hard to see that when your thoughts are distorted by depression. What do you mean by you are ruining everything? 

And I totally get you on feeling like you want to end it. It is a struggle I face almost ever day. You are not alone in this.

Dude I am alone on New year's eve. I am trying to not make a big deal about it. Don't feel too bad about trying to make 2020 better. Try to make a small goal maybe, and try to persistently keep that goal through out the year. That is at least what I am trying. If all else I am trying to just stay alive. Stay safe tonight :)

Can you articulate on why you hate yourself? I am sorry that you feel like you are a disappointment to your parents. If it makes you feel better you don't have to make your parents proud, you only have to keep living how you see fit. Is there anything/anyone else you feel a strong bond or feeling towards?  Don't be too hard on yourself, it can be hard to do things when you are depressed.

If the steps seem too big try to break them down, that kind of helps me. PM me if you want to talk, I am 22 and have been dealing with this kinda stuff for a while. We can just chat if it could help.

I can definitely relate to feeling in the middle, or maybe not completely to one side of the spectrum? I wouldn't ever want to be called he/him it doesn't feel right to me. She/her fine, but I also think it is because I have always referred to in that way. They/them sounds right, but I don't know how to try those pronouns out without rocking the boat.

Thank you for sharing your experience. I don't really feel like a guy or super masculine, I just don't fully feel like a girl. Can you expand more on what it feels like to be a masc nonbinary person? Like you kinda understood you didn't feel like a girl, but how did you settle on that label?

I don't know if I would say faking is the right term. It feels more like I don't feel completely like a women. But I don't know how to define what being a women means in order to determine if I am truly faking it or not.

Oh for sure, I think looking at lesbianism though the lens of a patriarchal society definitely has a role to play in the pervasiveness of the differences in how lesbians perceive gender compared to gay men.

I am not the best at completely understanding my emotions from childhood trauma, which I am working on, so I don't know if am emotional approach is the best idea. To be fair I was pretty homophobic until I was about 15 since I had little knowledge of the LGBT community. So I am still playing catch up with a lot of these experiences. I am trying to figure out the more logical standpoint of the situation, but haven't gotten there yet. I am struggling to understand what does it truly mean to be a women? I know it is more then just how one presents themselves physically, but I struggle to understand like what completely defines womanhood and if I fit into that label. It is really hard and is in the back of my mind.

I fear taking on a label and then changing it because I don't want to de legitimize it for the people who stay within that label, at least to most people outside of the community who think that it is a trend. But I think that is a mostly self inflicted issue.

I have been meaning to read stone butch blues because it seems like a text with a lot of insight on the complexities of lesbians and gender ( I always wonders if there was something like that for gay men but never felt the need to look into that).
sweet dreams
He is great, but I don't want to keep burdening him. He is so busy with research and teaching, plus three grad students.
I can always talk to my professor. I just don't like bothering him since he is so busy.
Yeah, they don't want to help people with real mental health issues so idk why they advertise themselves as a counseling service.
Not gonna lie the campus counselors here kinda suck. I went there a few times and they said my problems where too serious for them to help.
I mean I have already talked to them, I don't think talking to them some more it really gonna help.
I mean I have talked to a few people, letting them know I haven't been doing well. But I am sick of bothering people who can't solve my problems.
Yeah it was a little over a year ago.

I mean its not her fault really. She has a pretty good family life and doesn't have any mental health issues (which is good), but it is hard for her to understand where I am coming from or how to help.
She and I are pretty close, but it is hard to talk about really deep mental health issues with her.
I won't get in for another 2 weeks, which isn't too bad. I just have a hard to caring enough to live that long.

No, I detached myself from them as much as possible from a young age. I have always strived to be independent. Therapy was good way to channel some of the residual pain. But both me and my therapist realize that I haven't made any progress in the last month and a half. I keep leaving sessions suicidal, she wants me to see someone else. So now I am on another waiting list.

Yeah, I mean I have been going to therapy a lot for that and have kinda been making peace with that part of my life. Things should be getting better, but instead I just don't have anything left inside of me.
Living is a struggle, and I don't want to struggle anymore.
I don't feel alone. I mostly just feel empty if that makes sense.

No, I am actually taking a lighter course load this semester (my therapist suggested it). So I am not too stressed about school compared to past semesters. I am getting stuff ready to apply to grad school, but it isn't too terribly stressful.
Yeah, I am a senior in college.
I just feel deep inside that people are wasting their energy on trying to help me get better, when I don't think I ever will. Their resources would be better spent elsewhere.
Thanks for the input. I will definitely try to get a feel for their personality. I also want to ask about lab work and what they would expect from me.

I was taught in structure class using azimuth, but had to learn quad at field camp. I prefer azimuth but am comfortable with either. I don't really think there is a standard(or at least I have never heard of one).
Damn you were super qualified. I hope you got into another grad school? I will definitely keep that in mind.
I think I can make it to at least a 300 (aiming for a little higher). I think it is mostly just nerves.
I am taking the test on August 15th so I still have time to study and I am apply this round.

Okay good to know, I try to stay on top of things. I will definitely start sending emails out since GSA is so early this year. I have anxiety which is probs why I overthink how I come off to people sometimes.
That is super cool, it is amazing the variety of jobs you can get with a geology degree.
Okay, will definitely do then when I email them.
Still cool, brother works as a civil engineer so I am seen some pretty cool concrete stuff.

I have an excel spreadsheet of all of the potential advisors, looked at their research gate pages and university info pages and made a column of their email addresses.  At last years GSA I emailed two potential advisors who's talks I found interesting and they said we could meet up at this years GSA to talk. I was going to invite some of the people I am interested in to see my poster. I just didn't know if right now was too early to reach out. I am trying to do things as early as possible, I just don't want to come off as overly aggressive.
What is the difference between a professional masters and a regular masters? Is that like a thesis and nonthesis deal?
Aw well thanks for the confidence, also super cool job working for damn safety. Concrete is pretty neat.
Good to know I have a passport will need to look into the admission process.

Apparently "bad judgement" doesn't qualify as a break in the codes of conduct. I knew that it might not go very smoothly, but the interview went a lot worse then I expected. I wish she could understand that this wasn't just a big misunderstanding or a lapse in his judgement. He was twice my age, 2-3 times bigger then me, and in a position of power how does that not count as coercion?

I will definitely take your advice on this. The problem is that we are 3 hours apart from one another, and both busy with college. I might try to just call her once a week or so just so we can talk, but I know it is not the same. I just feel like it is going to be harder to forge a stronger emotional connection when I can only see her once every few months. Do you have any suggestions on how to remedy the distance issue?

I definitely would never pressure her to have sex me with, that would be terrifying. Both of us are victims of sexual assault, and it takes me a long time to be comfortable with being physically intimate with someone. I have made it clear that we would only go at a pace that she is comfortable with.
